$comment: Production record, 29 Aug 2026, UNMODIFIED. The canonical lorastats dialect: bare field names, integer values, carrying fsk_received, rx_short_pkt and timespan. This is the dialect the schema encodes; the other two observed dialects dead-letter (ADR-007 §4). NOTE: production sends tenant == maintenant == "mzc", which is exactly the trap in claude/CLAUDE.md §6. This fixture is kept byte-faithful because its job is to be a production regression guard; it is NOT an isolation test. The *-tenant-isolation-pair.json fixtures, where the two values deliberately differ, remain the only isolation guards.
